name: lockyt
title: Lock
description: Locks resolved tickets and freeze articles on request. A locked ticket or a frozen article is read-only. To edit it, reopen the ticket or unfreeze the article first.

widgets.name: Lock
widgets.description: Sets who can reopen a locked ticket or unfreeze a frozen article, and which changes stay permitted.

widgets.name: Lock status
widgets.description: Shows if the article is frozen. Freezes or unfreezes the article.

widgets.name: Lock status
widgets.description: Shows that a resolved ticket is locked, and what the lock permits.
